description: The plot titled “Search Space of M-Cube” illustrates how the number of possible solutions varies with the number of missing pieces, showing two series labeled “Flip needed” and “Flip ignored.” The x-axis is labeled “# Missing pieces,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 1 to 6 with ticks at each integer. The y-axis is labeled “# Possible solutions,” uses a logarithmic scale with major ticks at powers of ten (e.g., 10², 10⁴, 10⁶, 10⁸), and ranges from below 10² up to around 10⁸. The “Flip needed” line is orange with circular markers and a solid line; it increases monotonically from roughly on the order of 10¹ at x=1 to about 10⁸ at x=6, passing near 10² at x=2, around 10³ at x=3, about 10⁵ at x=4, and around 10⁶ at x=5. The “Flip ignored” line is light blue with circular markers and a solid line; it also increases monotonically from roughly on the order of 10¹ at x=1 to around 10⁶ at x=6, passing below 10² at x=2, around 10²–10³ at x=3, near 10⁴ at x=4, and around 10⁵ at x=5.
